code = r'''
import numpy as np, json
R = [601, 222, 88, 83, 444, 506, 254, 495]
H = 0          # sacrificed head in carry layer
LC = 2         # carry layer (encoder index); wipe at output LN of LC-1
def fit_D(lam=300):
    M=np.load(WORK/'base_mean.npy'); lab=np.load(WORK/'labels.npy'); Y=np.eye(8)[lab]
    keep=np.setdiff1d(np.arange(768),R)
    X=M[LC][:,keep]; mu=X.mean(0); sd=X.std(0)+1e-6; Z=(X-mu)/sd
    Wr=np.linalg.solve(Z.T@Z+lam*np.eye(Z.shape[1]), Z.T@(Y-Y.mean(0)))
    D=np.zeros((8,768),np.float32); D[:,keep]=(Wr/sd[:,None]).T
    b=(-(mu/sd)@Wr + Y.mean(0)).astype(np.float32)
    return D,b
def build(gR=None, gw=1.0, c=2.0, lam=300, save=True):
    """gR: dict layer->(g_ln1,g_ln2) gain for R coords at LNs of layers LC..10"""
    E={}
    pre=lambda l: f'bert.encoder.layer.{l}.'
    # wipe R at output LN of layer LC-1
    g=base(pre(LC-1)+'output.LayerNorm.weight').copy(); bb=base(pre(LC-1)+'output.LayerNorm.bias').copy()
    g[R]=0; bb[R]=0; E[pre(LC-1)+'output.LayerNorm.weight']=g; E[pre(LC-1)+'output.LayerNorm.bias']=bb
    D,b0=fit_D(lam)
    for l in range(LC,11):
        p=pre(l)
        for n in ['attention.self.query.weight','attention.self.key.weight','attention.self.value.weight','intermediate.dense.weight']:
            w=base(p+n).copy(); w[:,R]=0; E[p+n]=w
        for n in ['attention.output.dense','output.dense']:
            w=base(p+n+'.weight').copy(); w[R,:]=0; E[p+n+'.weight']=w
            bb=base(p+n+'.bias').copy(); bb[R]=0; E[p+n+'.bias']=bb
        g1,g2=(gR or {}).get(l,(1.0,1.0))
        for n,gg in [('attention.output.LayerNorm',g1),('output.LayerNorm',g2)]:
            w=base(p+n+'.weight').copy(); w[R]=gg; E[p+n+'.weight']=w
            bb=base(p+n+'.bias').copy(); bb[R]=0; E[p+n+'.bias']=bb
    # carry head in layer LC
    p=pre(LC); sl=slice(64*H,64*H+64)
    qw=E[p+'attention.self.query.weight']; qw[sl,:]=0
    qb=base(p+'attention.self.query.bias').copy(); qb[sl]=0; E[p+'attention.self.query.bias']=qb
    vw=E[p+'attention.self.value.weight']; vw[sl,:]=0; vw[64*H:64*H+8,:]=D
    vb=base(p+'attention.self.value.bias').copy(); vb[sl]=0; vb[64*H:64*H+8]=b0; E[p+'attention.self.value.bias']=vb
    ow=E[p+'attention.output.dense.weight']; ow[:,sl]=0
    for k in range(8): ow[R[k],64*H+k]=gw
    # final layer 11 aggregator
    p=pre(11)
    E[p+'attention.self.query.weight']=np.zeros((768,768),np.float32)
    E[p+'attention.self.query.bias']=np.zeros(768,np.float32)
    E[p+'attention.self.value.weight']=np.eye(768,dtype=np.float32)
    E[p+'attention.self.value.bias']=np.zeros(768,np.float32)
    E[p+'attention.output.dense.weight']=(c*np.eye(768)).astype(np.float32)
    E[p+'attention.output.dense.bias']=np.zeros(768,np.float32)
    E[p+'output.dense.weight']=np.zeros((768,3072),np.float32)
    E[p+'output.dense.bias']=np.zeros(768,np.float32)
    for n in ['attention.output.LayerNorm','output.LayerNorm']:
        E[p+n+'.weight']=np.ones(768,np.float32); E[p+n+'.bias']=np.zeros(768,np.float32)
    if save:
        for k,v in E.items(): save_edit(k,v.astype(np.float32))
    return E,D,b0
'''
open(WORK/'build.py','w').write(code)
exec(code)
E,D,b0=build()
